faq.a: To show the game on the TV, yes: a Chromecast or a TV with built-in Chromecast. Otherwise, open the link on a computer connected to the TV.

faq.q: Do guests need to install the app?
faq.a: No, they scan the QR code (or type the code) and play in their phone browser.

help.title: Help
help.sub: Trouble showing the game or joining? Here are the most common answers.

items.q: My TV doesn't show up in the list
items.a: Check that the phone and the Chromecast are on the same Wi-Fi network (not a guest network), with no VPN. On iPhone, also check that "Local Network" is turned on for Quiz'in in Settings, then restart the app.
Open the display link in the browser of a computer connected to the TV (HDMI cable) or of your smart TV, then go full screen.
Check that they scan the QR code on screen, or that they type the 4-character code correctly. An up-to-date browser is required.

items.q: How do I play in teams?
items.a: From 4 players, the teams option appears in the lobby settings.

legal.title: Legal information

privacySections.p: Quiz'in is published by Loann Courcoul, under the name HeroCorp (see the legal notice). The publisher decides how the data described here is used. Contact: quizinsupport@gmail.com.

No account is created. To play, you enter a first name (or nickname) and can pick an avatar. During a game we also record the game code, your answers, your scores, your drawings (in Draw Me) and the settings chosen by the host. An anonymous connection identifies your device while you play, with no link to your identity. We do not ask for an email, phone number, contacts, location, photos or microphone access. A nickname is enough: avoid entering your full name. Anonymous usage statistics. To improve the quizzes, the host's app sends aggregated counters: quizzes, modes and game types (chosen quiz, themes or mix) started, number of players per game, question reached and games finished (which lets us count abandoned games), number of answers and correct answers per question, and number of games per day. These counters contain no device identifier, first name, avatar, game code or individual answer, and cannot be linked to a person. As with any connection, Firebase's technical service receives the host's IP address to process the request; it is not stored in the counters.

Your name, avatar, answers and drawings are visible to the other players in the game and shown on the TV. The game code is the access key: only share it with your guests. Avoid putting personal information in your name or drawings.

privacySections.h: What the data is used for
privacySections.p: Only to run the game: connecting you, showing questions, counting points, showing answers and drawings. The legal basis is performance of the service (GDPR art. 6.1.b). We also rely on our legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse (art. 6.1.f). There are no ads, no data resale and no profiling, and the app uses no third-party analytics or crash reporting tool; only the anonymous counters described above are sent. The anonymous counters are only used to choose and fix the quizzes we offer; they are neither sold nor shared.

privacySections.h: Local network and casting to the TV
privacySections.p: To find your TV, the app asks for "local network" access on iPhone. It is only used to spot Chromecast devices on your Wi-Fi: no data is collected this way. Casting to the TV goes through Google Cast, a Google service.

We use Google: Firebase (anonymous sign-in, realtime database, page hosting) and Google Cast for casting. On the TV, the Cast player is loaded from Google's servers, which therefore receive the TV's IP address. If the Blind test is turned on, music previews are provided by Deezer, which may receive your IP address during playback. Apple and Google distribute the app and apply their own rules. We do not sell any data.

Game data is stored on Google's servers (Firebase Realtime Database), in Belgium, within the European Union. Anonymous sign-in (Firebase Authentication) is processed by Google in the United States; Google keeps IP addresses there for a few weeks. The site and game pages are served by Google's network (Firebase Hosting), present in several countries. We have no servers of our own. Transfers outside the European Union are covered by Google's standard contractual clauses or by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. On your phone (or in your browser), Quiz'in keeps a few local items: your sound setting, the questions already played, the answers given during the game, your anonymous identifier and, if you are the host and you play, your first name, avatar and your game code. They disappear when you uninstall the app or clear your browser data.

When the host leaves a game, it is deleted with all its content, drawings included. An abandoned game is deleted once the host has been away for more than 5 minutes, as long as a device in the game is still connected. In addition, an automatic cleanup deletes games older than about 24 hours. [TO CHECK: cleanup not yet in service.] The anonymous account holds neither your name nor your email, only a random identifier: Firebase keeps it until we delete it. On your device, it stays until you clear the app's data. You can ask us to delete it (see "Your rights"). Aggregated counters are kept for as long as the service exists, as they contain no personal data.
Quiz'in is made for family play. The app creates no account and shows no ads. We advise parents to accompany younger players and to choose a nickname rather than a full name.
Exchanges with the servers are encrypted (HTTPS) and access to the database is limited by security rules. No system is perfect: if something goes wrong, write to us.

You can ask for access to your data, its correction, its deletion, a restriction of its processing, or object to its processing (GDPR, art. 15 to 21). You can also withdraw a consent at any time. Write to quizinsupport@gmail.com: we reply within one month, free of charge. Since there is no account, we can only find you if you help us: give the game code, the name you used, the date and your phone type. If we cannot identify you with certainty, we cannot act on the request, so as not to hand someone else's data to the wrong person. If you think your rights are not respected, you can complain to the CNIL (cnil.fr, 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, France).
We may update this policy. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

termsSections.p: These terms govern the use of the Quiz'in app and website, published by Loann Courcoul under the name HeroCorp. By playing, you accept them.

Quiz'in is a quiz and mini-game party game for several players. The host starts the game from the app and shows it on a TV (with a Chromecast) or in a browser; guests join with a QR code or a code from their phone browser. The service is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. We may change it: new games, new features, changes or removal of some content.
No account is needed. You need an internet connection and, to show the game on a TV, a Chromecast or a Google Cast compatible TV. Equipment, connection and any internet access costs are yours.

Choose a name or nickname and make drawings that respect others. Unlawful, abusive, hateful, discriminatory, sexual or violent content is forbidden, as is anything that violates a person's privacy and any attempt to disrupt the service or bypass its protections. The host may remove a player from the game.

The host starts the game, picks the games and decides what is shown on the TV. They only share the code with their guests and remain responsible for how it is used in their home. When children play, an adult must accompany them.
Your answers, nickname and drawings remain yours. You only allow us to show them to the players and on the TV for the duration of the game. They are deleted with it (see the privacy policy).

The questions, design, logo, texts and code of Quiz'in belong to the publisher or its partners. You may use them to play, for personal use, but not copy or reuse them otherwise without written permission. Google, Chromecast, Google Cast and Deezer are trademarks of their owners; Quiz'in is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by them.

The service is provided as is, with no guarantee of continuous access: it may be interrupted for maintenance or in case of failure. Questions and answers may contain errors. To the extent permitted by law, the publisher is not liable for indirect damages related to the use of the service. Nothing here limits the rights the law gives you, in particular as a consumer.
How we handle your data is explained in the privacy policy.
We may change these terms. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page, and continuing to use Quiz'in after a change means you accept it.

These terms are governed by French law. In case of a dispute, write to us first: we will look for an amicable solution. Failing that, French courts have jurisdiction, without prejudice to the rules that protect consumers.
